patch.summary: Fly.io cost guide: researched plan structure, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Fly.io pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: Fly.io cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Fly.io against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (infrastructure monitoring, log management, CI/CD and automation) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Does not outrank Render (7.9) as the cloud-paas award. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Does not outrank Render (7.9) as the cloud-paas award

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Support Standard list price is support — not the hosting floor

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Legacy free allowance is not available to new accounts

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Not managed WordPress (WP Engine) or managed VMs (Cloudways) — landscape vs Cloudways

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Not ITSM, observability, a git host, or a panel licence
